[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 180
- Description: Inventory custody transfer: 39 Vivi/Oscar bars, Kirsten Ritschel → Gary Teh (QR decode + 2 movements + verification)
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1GE7PUq-UT6x2rBN-Q2ksogbWpgyuh2SaxJyG_uEK6PU
  - https://agroverse.shop/shipments/agl13/index.html
  
  Details:
  CONTRIBUTION: End-to-end custody transfer of 39 chocolate bars from Kirsten Ritschel to Gary Teh, from a zip of 39 iPhone HEIC photos to verified ledger + QR-sheet state.
  
  SCOPE / QR DECODING
  - Extracted vivi_chocolate_bars.zip; converted 39 HEIC photos to JPEG (heif-convert + pillow_heif).
  - Decoded QR codes with zxingcpp at 1600px upscale, OpenCV/WeChat fallback for failures. Result: 39 unique codes, 0 unreadable, 0 duplicates, 0 multi-code images.
  - Identified two distinct currency batches:
    * 37 × "Agroverse 81% Cacao Chocolate Bar 50g | Vivi Cacao Nibs | Kirsten 20261025 | San Francisco - AGL13"
    * 2 × "Agroverse 81% Cacao Chocolate Bar 50g | Oscar Cacao Nibs | Kirsten 20261027 | San Francisco - MAIN"
  - Flagged serial gaps in the 2025_20261025 run (48 serials exist, 37 in the zip); the missing 2025_20261025_7 was later confirmed already SOLD.
  
  RESEARCH / DIAGNOSIS
  - Traced INVENTORY MOVEMENT semantics through process_movement_telegram_logs.gs (~1800 lines, targeted reads).
  - Established that the destination ledger is derived from the QR sheet's ledger column (col C), resolved against the "Shipment Ledger Listing" tab - NOT from the submission's "Destination Inventory File Location", which is used only as the GitHub URL for the attached photo (L1069-1099). This corrects the long-standing OPEN_FOLLOWUPS.md note that the field was blocking movements.
  - Confirmed resolveCurrencyLedger() preserves an explicit rule that AGL4 movements stay offchain, which is why the 2 Oscar bars correctly post to the offchain ledger despite currency text reading MAIN.
  - Cross-checked schema via tokenomics/SCHEMA.md, search_context and search_code to rule out a separate "RSA contract" for the movement.
  
  EXECUTION
  - Governor-directed pre-step: set QR sheet col U (Manager Name) to "Kirsten Ritschel" for all 39 rows so sender-side inventory counts stay accurate. Backup captured first (PRE_KIRSTEN_MGR_BACKUP_20261126_212746.json); 39/39 verified in sheet before any submission.
  - Submitted 2 x [INVENTORY MOVEMENT], split by ledger rather than one movement of 39.
  
  VERIFICATION (read back, not assumed)
  - Ledger double-entry posted: AGL13 r79 Kirsten Ritschel -37 / r80 Gary Teh +37; offchain r6120 Kirsten Ritschel -2 / r6121 Gary Teh +2.
  - Processor's col-U update failed silently on all 39 codes; completed the write manually and verified 39/39 = Gary Teh.
  - Final AGL13 81% bar balance: Gary Teh 36 (37 received minus 1 already sold via SALES EVENT on 2025_20261025_7), Kirsten Ritschel 3. Offchain: Gary Teh 2, Kirsten Ritschel 50.
  
  FINDINGS SURFACED TO GOVERNOR
  - Bug: updateAgroverseQrManagerName() fails silently in the processor - a movement can commit to the ledger while the QR sheet still names the wrong holder, which is exactly the desync the pre-step was meant to prevent.
  - Pre-existing phantom in offchain r6124/r6125: the -12 leg is booked against "Sophia Truesight", leaving a non-zero agent balance and inflating Kirsten's offchain count by 12. Correction pair proposed, not executed (inventory-affecting, needs explicit go).
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 300.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
--------
